title: 맥세이프 카드지갑 교통카드가 '한 장만 대주세요'로 안 찍힐 때, 같이 넣은 카드부터 빼 보세요
description: 카드지갑 교통카드가 안 찍히면 교통카드 기능이 없는 비접촉 카드와 휴대폰 NFC 겹침부터 봅니다.

brief.moment: a person presses the back of a phone, with a slim magnetic card wallet attached, against a Korean subway gate reader; the reader glows red and the gate flaps stay shut while a short line of Korean commuters waits behind
brief.angle: low side view from turnstile height, looking slightly up past the reader toward the person and the queue
brief.light: flat cool overhead tube lighting mixed with a small warm red glow from the reader that tints the fingertips
brief.lens: 35mm equivalent at about two meters, moderate depth of field so the waiting commuters behind are soft but readable as people
brief.medium: gouache illustration with visible brush grain and slightly muted subway colors

title: 아이폰 미러링에 삼성 TV가 안 뜰 때, 같은 Wi-Fi·AirPlay·2018년 모델부터 확인하세요
description: 아이폰 미러링에 삼성 TV가 안 뜨면 같은 Wi-Fi, AirPlay 켬, 2018년 이후 모델부터 봅니다.

brief.moment: late evening, a person sits on the floor in front of a low sofa holding a phone toward a large wall-mounted TV; the phone shows a small spinning connection indicator while the TV screen stays on a plain dark-blue idle background with nothing appearing
brief.angle: high corner view from near the ceiling behind the sofa, looking down diagonally over the person's shoulder toward the TV
brief.light: dim room lit only by a single warm floor lamp at the far left and the cold glow of the idle TV, creating a warm-cool split across the person's back
brief.lens: 24mm wide-angle equivalent from about three meters back, deep focus so the phone, the person and the TV are all sharp
brief.medium: two-color risograph print look in teal and warm orange with visible halftone dots and slight ink misregistration

title: 비스포크 AI 콤보 사기 전에 세탁실 높이 1,120mm와 진입로 너비부터 재 보세요
description: 비스포크 AI 콤보는 세탁실 높이 1,120mm, 진입로 너비 700mm부터 재 봅니다.

brief.moment: a person kneels in an empty laundry spot and pulls a metal tape measure straight up from the floor toward the underside of a low wall cabinet, the tape bending slightly as it touches the cabinet, the person's face turned up with a doubtful look as if the height might be too short
brief.angle: straight-on frontal view at standing chest height from the open utility room doorway, level horizon
brief.light: soft overcast morning daylight coming sideways through the frosted window on the right, no artificial light, gentle long shadows on the tiles
brief.lens: 50mm normal lens equivalent from about 1.5 meters, shallow depth of field focused on the tape touching the cabinet edge
brief.medium: colored pencil illustration on cold-press textured paper with visible pencil strokes and light paper grain
